reasoning_chain: Multiple slow edges radiate from frontend to many different callees including productcatalogservice, cartservice, checkoutservice, currencyservice, recommendationservice, shippingservice, and adservice.
All these callees have low p95 latencies themselves, indicating they are not slow processing requests but requests queue before frontend gets CPU.
Frontend CPU usage is at 79% of its 10m core limit, indicating CPU throttling and resource exhaustion.
Adservice shows some errors but only from frontend, and adservice itself is not slow, so errors are likely propagated from frontend delays.
Frontend pod was recently recreated with a CPU limit reduction from 200m to 10m, likely causing the resource exhaustion.
No other service shows multiple independent callers slow or erroring towards it, so frontend is the root cause.
